questions.question: Use breaking down and building up to work out 34 526 + 23 251.
Use rounding off and compensating to work out 76 412 − 19 998. Explain the last step.
questions.expected_answer: Take away 20 000 instead: 76 412 − 20 000 = 56 412. You took away 2 too many, so add 2 back: 56 414.

questions.question: Show two ways to check that 248 635 + 99 999 = 348 634.
questions.expected_answer: Inverse operation: 348 634 − 99 999 = 248 635, which is the number we started with. Estimate: about 250 000 + 100 000 = 350 000, which is close to 348 634.
